props.name: isActive

props.name: isComplete

props.name: isLast
props.description:
Is last?

props.name: stepNumber
props.description:
Step number

- Dynically set by the parent

props.name: variant
props.description:
Variant
- **default** renders a Stepper item with a horizontal layout
- **vertical** renders a Stepper item with a vertical layout
